dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's ninety baht. Do you want a plastic bag?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnaɪnti ˈbɑːt. duː juː ˈwɑːnt ə ˌplæstɪk ˈbæɡ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, thanks. Oh no! I don't have enough money.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈθæŋks. ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How much do you need? Here's fifty baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ duː juː ˈniːd? hɪrz ˈfɪfti ˈbɑːt.
